items.description: POSTing a stock record to the API with a uuid-suffixed SKU, a uuid-suffixed location, a quantity, and a combined inventory_code returns a 2xx response and the response body contains those exact four fields
running alembic downgrade to the revision before stock_records followed by alembic upgrade head completes without error on the real branch (@pytest.mark.migration, never downgrade base)
rows seeded with per-run-unique keys immediately after migration upgrade head retain their original stored values when queried on the real branch
the boundary module app/routes/ contains no import of the SQLAlchemy Session object
the boundary module app/routes/ contains no SQLAlchemy ORM model or query import of any kind
the service module app/services/ contains no SQLAlchemy ORM import of any kind
no session mutation call (add, commit, flush, or delete) exists in any file outside app/repositories/
no hardcoded database connection string appears in any application source file under app/
the application reads DATABASE_URL directly from the environment without substituting or overriding the database name to an app-specific value
inserting a stock_records row with sku set to NULL is rejected by the real-branch database
inserting a stock_records row with location set to NULL is rejected by the real-branch database
inserting a stock_records row with quantity set to NULL is rejected by the real-branch database
inserting a stock_records row with inventory_code set to NULL is rejected by the real-branch database
inserting a stock_records row with quantity less than zero is rejected by the real-branch database ck_stock_records_quantity_non_negative CHECK constraint
the service layer raises a rejection error for a negative-quantity write before any database write is issued
a request carrying an invalid field value returns an error payload whose body names the specific offending field rather than a generic message
GETting the stock record that was just filed returns a response whose quantity and combined inventory_code are byte-for-byte identical to the values supplied in the original POST
no server-side template rendering call exists in any file under app/routes/ and all stock endpoints return JSON content-type responses
POSTing a second stock filing for the same uuid-suffixed SKU and location pair results in exactly one record being returned by a subsequent GET for that pair
inserting a second stock_records row for an existing per-run-unique (sku, location) pair on the real branch collapses to exactly one row for that pair
two concurrent upserts targeting the same per-run-unique (sku, location) pair on the real branch produce exactly one stored row for that pair
a collision upsert on an existing per-run-unique (sku, location) pair on the real branch does not alter the row's created_at timestamp
